summary: Confirmed for 11–13 December 2026 at Wisdom Valley near Pattaya, Chonburi: this is a separate festival excursion from Bangkok. Strong candidate for committed electronic-music fans seeking elaborate staging and a large international crowd. The crucial constraint is access: the official site currently says sold out, so keep it conditional until a legitimate ticket is secured.
whyGo: A full-scale Tomorrowland production with themed stages and an immersive festival atmosphere.
Combine an electronic-music weekend with a Pattaya-area stay; choose one day or the whole weekend if legitimate inventory becomes available.
bestFor: Electronic-music fans comfortable with dense crowds and loud amplified sound.
Travellers willing to devote several days and a substantial budget to a major event.
skipIf: You need an easy Bangkok evening outing or a flexible walk-in activity.
You are under 20, dislike crowds or late nights, or cannot secure an official ticket.
duration: One long festival day or the full three-day weekend; add travel and recovery time.
cost: Published sold-out face values: day ฿5,100; three-day ฿12,500; VIP day ฿8,200; VIP weekend ฿20,200. Add accommodation, transfers, food and drinks. Free bracelet collection; optional Treasure Case/shipping extra. These are reference prices, not available offers.
hours: 11–12 December: 13:00–01:00; 13 December: 13:00–00:00. Last check-in 22:00 Friday/Saturday and 21:00 Sunday. No same-day re-entry.
bestTime: Arrive early enough to clear entry and explore stages before the evening crowd; choose a day after checking the official artist timetable.
gettingThere: Wisdom Valley is in the Pattaya/Chonburi area, outside Bangkok. Base nearby rather than assuming a convenient late-night return to Bangkok. Official hotel packages describe daily festival shuttles from participating hotels in Pattaya, Chonburi and Rayong; exact independent transport schedules and fares were not verified.
booking: Official festival passes and the main welcome page state sold out. Start only at thailand.tomorrowland.com to check legitimate options and rules; do not assume an advertised resale ticket can be transferred. Entry requires a pass registered in your name.
accessibility: Specific wheelchair routes, viewing arrangements and accessible transport were not verified. Ask the organizer before committing; the outdoor grounds and prolonged standing may matter.
practicalTips: Minimum age is strictly 20 on the festival date; bring identification matching the registered ticket.
Plan hearing protection, comfortable footwear, hydration and your return journey before arrival.
Do not leave the grounds expecting to come back that day.
decemberNotes: This is specifically 11–13 December 2026, not a recurring attraction available throughout the month. Reserve refundable nearby lodging only after confirming admission. Outdoor heat, sun and possible weather disruption still warrant preparation.
uncertainties: Future event: operations, performances and schedules may change before December.
Official pages conflict on stage count: welcome page says six while a June lineup announcement says seven; avoid treating either as final.
Current authorized resale availability, accessible facilities and detailed transport arrangements remain unverified.
